{{Use dmy dates|date=April 2024}} {{Infobox award | name = 2011 FIFA Ballon d'Or | subheader = | image = Lionel Messi Player of the Year 2011.jpg | image_size = | alt = | caption = 2011 FIFA Ballon d'Or winner, [[Lionel Messi]] | awarded_for = | date = {{start date|2012|01|09|df=y}} | location = [[Zürich]], Switzerland | country = Switzerland | presenter = FIFA | host = | former name = | preshow_host = | acts = | website = {{URL|ballondor.com}} | runtime = | award1_type = Won by | award1_winner = {{flagicon|Argentina}} [[Lionel Messi]] (3rd [[Ballon d'Or]]) | previous = [[2010 FIFA Ballon d'Or|2010]] | main = [[FIFA Ballon d'Or]] | next = [[2012 FIFA Ballon d'Or|2012]] }} The '''2011 [[FIFA Ballon d'Or]]''' ({{lit|'''2011 FIFA Golden Ball'''}}), was the second year for FIFA's awards for the top football players and coaches of the year. The awards were given out in [[Zürich]] on 9 January 2012, with [[Lionel Messi]] claiming the title of world player of the year for the third time in a row.{{cite web|url=http://soccernet.espn.go.com/news/story/_/id/1006543/2011-fifa-ballon-d%27or%3A-lionel-messi-crowned-world%27s-best?cc=5739|title=Messi crowned world's best|date=9 January 2012|work=[[ESPN]]|access-date=9 January 2012|archive-date=12 January 2012|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120112032112/http://soccernet.espn.go.com/news/story/_/id/1006543/2011-fifa-ballon-d%27or%3A-lionel-messi-crowned-world%27s-best?cc=5739|url-status=dead}}{{cite web|url=https://www.fifa.com/ballondor/media/newsid=1565969/|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120112062307/http://www.fifa.com/ballondor/media/newsid=1565969/|url-status=dead|archive-date=12 January 2012|title=Messi, Sawa, Guardiola and Sasaki triumph at FIFA Ballon d'Or 2011 |date=9 January 2012|work=[[FIFA|FIFA.com]]|access-date=9 January 2012}} The gala ceremony was hosted by former Ballon d'Or winner [[Ruud Gullit]] and broadcast journalist Kay Murray of [[Real Madrid TV]] and [[Fox Soccer Channel]], with singer-songwriter [[James Blunt]] and his band providing musical entertainment.{{citation needed|date=May 2020}} == Winners and nominees == === FIFA Ballon d'Or === The top three nominees for the 2011 FIFA Ballon d'Or were: {{multiple image | align = right | direction = vertical | width = | header = | width1 = 165 | image1 = Lionel Messi Player of the Year 3, 2011.jpg|thumb | alt1 = | caption1 = [[Lionel Messi]] | width2 = 165 | image2 = Cristiano Ajax.jpg|thumb | alt2 = | caption2 = [[Cristiano Ronaldo]] | width3 = 165 | image3 = Xavi Hernández - 002.jpg|thumb | alt3 = | caption3 = [[Xavi (footballer, born 1980)|Xavi]] }} {| class="wikitable" !
